record.title: Reduce sealed RF records and quantify comparison limits
record.intent: Turn retained measurements into reproducible relative and, where supported, absolute response estimates.
requirements: Work offline from sealed records using the frozen estimator and normalization. Exercise known-amplitude synthetic records and malformed/incomplete controls before interpreting physical results.

Check scaling/preambles, actual sampling, completeness and decimation; retain fit residuals, repeat dispersion and baseline-return drift. Missing arms remain missing rather than being inferred from expected behavior.

Separate relative policy effects from corrected absolute response; quantify supported uncertainty and unresolved source/spectral/loading effects. An uncharacterized chain cannot establish calibrated absolute bandwidth.

Produce reproducible tables/plots with explicit scope and data exclusions, keeping unit identifiers and raw private evidence out of source. Reuse the typed workspace conventions for any necessary Python implementation.
acceptance: Reproducible reduction supports scoped response estimates or an explicit finding that the retained data cannot answer the declared question.

review.rationale: Reviewed acquisition contract after owned-server containment stop. All four prerequisite-only attempts contain no RF records. New host lifecycle and command timing preparation does not change waveform qualification,75slots,return controls or primary contrast. Reduction remains applicable only to sealed actual records or explicit unavailable disposition; preparation is not acquisition.
